Definition: of Hebrew origin (H6017); Gomorrha (i.e. Amorah), a place near the Dead Sea:--Gomorrha.
BiblicalUsage: The word Gómorrha carries the sense of Gomorrah, a city near the Dead Sea. In Matthew 10:15, the text says "It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment."
TheologicalSignificance: I read gómorrha plainly — it means Gomorrah, a city near the Dead Sea, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
